item.title: Senate passes bill raising corporate tax rate to 25% after loophole review - Example Daily
item.description: The Senate voted 52-48 to raise the corporate tax rate to 25 percent while closing several loopholes identified in a GAO review. Critics say the change will slow hiring.

item.title: Corporate tax hike heads to House as business groups mobilize
item.description: After the Senate vote on the corporate tax rate increase to 25%, business lobbies are pressing House lawmakers to strip the loophole provisions from the bill.

item.title: City council approves new bike lanes downtown
item.description: The council approved 12 miles of protected bike lanes in a 7-2 vote.
